examples.name: Default
examples.summary: A list of resources inside `ContextMenu.Trigger`. Right-click a row, press `Shift+F10` or the context-menu key on a focused row, or long-press it on touch: the menu opens at the pointer (or under the row) and focus returns to the row on close. Read which row was targeted from a native `@contextmenu` on the row.

examples.name: WithSubMenu
examples.summary: Panel forced open (`:open="true"`) to show the anatomy it shares with `DropdownMenu`: groups, a `command` hint, an open `Sub` (`default-open`) and `kind="checkbox"` items that keep the panel open.

examples.name: Disabled
examples.summary: `disabled` leaves the area to the browser: right-click shows the native context menu and the panel never opens.
